By Store Complexity

  • Basic setup (template theme, minimal customization): $500–$5,000
  • Mid-complexity build (customized theme, several integrations, moderate catalog): $10,000–$25,000
  • Full custom development (bespoke design, complex features, large catalog): $25,000–$50,000+
  • Enterprise / Shopify Plus builds: $50,000–$200,000+

Here, you will find that the store’s complexity is the single biggest driver for the costs. A small catalog with a lightly customized theme costs a fraction of what a multi-market, highly automated store requires.

Theme Customization

  • Standard theme, light customization: $500–$2,000
  • Customized existing theme (colors, sections, layout changes): $2,000–$10,000
  • Fully custom theme built from scratch: $10,000–$20,000+, and can reach $25,000–$50,000+ for Shopify Plus-level builds

The jump between “customizing a theme” and “building one from scratch” is significant. Custom builds typically involve hundreds of developer hours, covering planning, front-end architecture, QA, and revisions once real data hits the store.

Integrations

  • Standard app integrations (2–5 essential apps): usually included in setup or a few hundred dollars each
  • Advanced integrations (10+ apps, custom configuration): adds meaningful cost as depth increases
  • Complex integrations (ERP, CRM, PIM, custom APIs): $10,000–$50,000, depending on how many systems need to talk to each other

If your business runs on multiple back-end systems, integration work is often where budgets get underestimated. Ask any potential partner to scope this specifically, not as a vague line item.

Custom Apps

  • Focused checkout or theme extensions: $8,000–$30,000
  • Standard custom Shopify app: $30,000–$50,000+
  • Shopify Plus-level apps (using Functions, Flow, B2B price lists): often start at $50,000 and can exceed $200,000 for high-volume, multi-location businesses

Custom app development is its own category of cost, separate from store development, and scales heavily with how deep it goes into Shopify’s enterprise-only APIs.

Shopify Plus Requirements

A standard Shopify Plus build typically starts around $15,000–$25,000. Larger Plus implementations, especially those involving custom checkout logic, B2B catalogs, or multi-store setups, commonly land between $25,000 and $100,000+.

Don’t Forget Ongoing Costs

The build fee is only part of the picture. Once your store is live, expect recurring Shopify expert costs for:

  • Platform subscription (Shopify plan)
  • Paid apps
  • Maintenance and support (commonly $1,000–$10,000+/month, depending on store complexity)
  • Payment processing fees

A cheaper build can end up costing more over the first year if these ongoing expenses aren’t planned for upfront.

How to Get an Accurate Number

Wide ranges exist because five variables shape every quote: project type, design complexity, catalog size, integrations required, and developer or agency location. Any partner who gives you a firm number without asking about these is guessing.

The Bottom Line

Custom Shopify development cost depends far more on complexity and integration depth than just the platform itself.

So, before you ever request a quote, you should be clear on your own catalog size, integration needs, and whether Shopify Plus is actually necessary, because that alone is gonna narrow the range from “useless” to “actionable.”
